review_type: Independent hostile review of integration and modeling claims; no model trained
overall_verdict: The audits support carefully scoped benchmark construction and hypothesis tests. They do not establish that combining twenty databases produces a reliable general cell-selective mRNA/circRNA translation model.
user_critique_adopted: Use cell-selective protein expression unless the endpoint separates translation from RNA exposure, abundance and persistence.
Treat protein output, ribosome occupancy/loading, editing classification, coding potential, binding and modification state as different endpoints.
Narrow novelty to a quantitative endpoint, explicit cellular context, experimental RNA format and a demonstrated generalization setting.
An endpoint protein/RNA ratio does not by itself establish instantaneous translation rate because protein synthesis and degradation have a history.
Existing RiboNN, ContiTE, RiboDecode, PARADE, CICADA and cirCodAn prevent broad claims that sequence-context or circRNA translation prediction is new.

defensible_combinations.labels: Original measured/processed RiboNN publisher atlas or explicitly matched study Ribo-seq and RNA-seq, with source preprocessing retained
defensible_combinations.context_features: Cell-identity-reconciled HPA or DepMap RNA expression as external proxy features; original paired RNA profiles are preferable where available
defensible_combinations.reference_features: Matched transcript annotation and optional source-context ENCODE/POSTAR binding annotations
defensible_combinations.defensible_claim: Whether selected cellular features improve held-out endogenous TE prediction relative to established sequence-only, multi-context and few-shot baselines
conditions: Resolve exact original dataset file/version and missingness before reporting final scale
Preserve gene/transcript annotation, species, study, biological condition and source split
Use study- and cell-held-out evaluation for the corresponding generalization claims
Treat external HPA/DepMap measurements as unmatched context proxies, not contemporaneous measured state
Use one deduplicated source atlas when comparing RiboNN and ContiTE; ContiTE is not an independent measurement cohort

defensible_combinations.task: Synthetic circRNA IRES reporter relative-output benchmark
defensible_combinations.labels: LAMAR released relative Fluc circRNA reporter-output measurements
defensible_combinations.context_features: A restricted human-cell subset with candidate HPA/DepMap matches after resolving source stock/subline identities; keep mouse contexts separate
defensible_combinations.auxiliary_data: Chen2021 circRNA reporter assay can support separate representation/pretraining objectives after sequence-family deduplication; it must retain its own assay head
defensible_combinations.defensible_claim: Whether biological proxy features improve prediction of the specific measured relative-output endpoint in held-out IRES families or cells
conditions: One released scalar per pair does not provide replicate-level uncertainty
305 sequences measured in13 cells are not3915 independent sequence examples or3915 independent cell contexts
The cell-feature sample size is at most13 distinct contexts before species and identity exclusions
Reference-linear-mRNA normalization makes the endpoint a relative advantage; cell effects can arise in the denominator
No delivered RNA persistence, exposure or time-resolved protein trajectories are supplied by the reviewed matrix

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: tRNA mechanism is not identifiable from an IRES-only library with a shared reporter CDS
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: LAMAR varies IRES inserts in a shared Fluc reporter. A CDS-codon-by-tRNA-context claim needs variation in the coding sequence and measured functional tRNA contexts. Cell-level tRNA features could otherwise explain only global cell/reference differences.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Keep tRNA-aware CDS optimization as a separate hypothesis requiring an appropriate CDS-varying matched dataset.

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: Cross-assay pooling and false external validation
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: LAMAR relative luminescence, Albatross polysome-derived loading, Chen weighted fluorescence bins, Fan motif enrichment and endogenous TE are not the same target. Standardizing labels does not make their biology equivalent.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Use separate study/assay heads and report assay-specific performance. Albatross can test mechanistic/ranking concordance where justified, but is not a direct external validation of absolute protein-output accuracy.

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: Cell identity is not measured cell state
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: Every candidate HPA/DepMap-to-reporter join in the context audit has matched_assay_condition=false. Shared names do not establish matching stock, medium, passage, perturbation or differentiation. Selected tModBase HepG2 values are from an ALKBH7-mutant-rescue condition, not a generic untreated HepG2 state.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Label features external proxies and conduct sensitivity analyses; do not infer causal regulators or interpolate treatments from baseline labels.

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: Pseudo-replication, sequence reuse and train/test leakage
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: The same sequence occurs in several cells; Chen and Weingarten reuse a nominal library; RiboNN/ContiTE reuse the atlas; aggregators overlap study accessions; HPA/DepMap can overlap CCLE provenance.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Deduplicate upstream records, split by sequence family/gene and source study, and use crossed cell-by-sequence holdouts for joint generalization. Fit preprocessing and feature selection only on training domains.

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: Reference annotations cannot be treated as missing output labels
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: circAtlas coordinates, riboCIRC inferred translation evidence, CircTarget interactions, MODOMICS chemistry, RNALocate localization, RASP reactivity and CLIP binding have no compatible reporter-output response variable. Unsupported or missing evidence is not a true inactive example.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Use them as explicitly typed annotations or auxiliary objectives; never silently turn absence into a negative output label.

critical_failures_to_avoid.issue: Mechanism-component scores do not predict complete sensor circuits
critical_failures_to_avoid.reason: ADAR editing-site classification, miRNA binding support, RNA accessibility and protein tethering screens do not measure synthetic-sensor activation, leakage and selectivity jointly.
critical_failures_to_avoid.action: Require matched sensor design, target/off-target context, activation and leakage labels for a sensor-performance claim.

minimum_baseline_and_evaluation_contract: Compare global/sequence-only predictions, cell offsets, additive sequence-plus-cell models and a regularized interaction model before a large neural context model.
For circRNA report target-versus-off-target contrasts and within-cell/within-sequence rankings, not only pooled correlation dominated by global effects.
Distinguish new-sequence, new-cell and simultaneous-new-sequence-and-cell tests. Learned cell identity does not give zero-shot predictions for arbitrary new cells.
Few-shot target-cell adaptation must use a separate support set; support labels cannot be counted as zero-shot performance or leak into query evaluation.
Compare endogenous mRNA against RiboNN/ContiTE/RiboDecode as appropriate; compare UTR reporter approaches against PARADE in the corresponding experimental format.
Report uncertainty at the sequence-family, cell or study level justified by the available replication; row bootstrapping alone understates uncertainty.
